name: Stainless Steel Tie Clip
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from durable stainless steel, this tie clip features a sleek and polished finish designed for long-lasting use.

- Its sturdy construction provides reliable performance while maintaining a refined and professional appearance.

- Available in Silver, Gold, and Rose Gold finishes to match different personal styles.

- Features a rich natural wood grain, a soft, protective black velvet lining inside to cradle the tie clip, and a magnetic closure to keep it secure.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
 - Tie clip size: Measuring approximately 2.17 in (5.5 cm) in length with a 1.18 in (3 cm) round decorative plate, this compact tie clip is designed to securely hold your tie in place without adding bulk.

 - Wooden gift box: A compact, perfectly proportioned oval shape measuring 2.17 in x 2.17 in x 2.17in .


Printing + Engraving  Technology:

-The round decorative plate supports UV printing, allowing your custom photos, designs, or meaningful artwork to be displayed with clear and vibrant details. 

- The tie bar also supports engraving for adding names, initials, or special messages.

 

Functional & Usage:
- Designed to keep your tie neatly secured and in place, this tie clip combines everyday functionality with a personalized touch.

- Its classic clip design is suitable for weddings, business attire, formal events, and daily wear

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
With its stunning customization and elegant wooden packaging, this tie clip is the ultimate gift to celebrate life's most meaningful moments:

  • Weddings: An exceptional gift for the Groom, Groomsmen, Best Man, or Father of the Bride.
  • Milestones: Perfect for Anniversaries, Father’s Day, Birthdays, graduations, or job promotions.
  • Corporate Gifts: Commemorate company milestones or thank valued clients with a subtle, branded accessory.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Stainless Steel Tie Clip

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
